profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer Manager
profile.summary:
Strong leadership and software engineering background with proven experience in the development of software-driven systems, a willingness to work with stakeholders to deliver the product they desire, knowledge of best software engineering practices, and ability to quickly learn new systems and technologies

Specialties: .NET (C#, ASP.NET, Blazor), C++, client-server application development, tools development, server-side gameplay systems, distributed architecture

positions.title: Level IV Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Metroid Prime 4: Beyond
- Metroid Prime Remastered (Switch)
- Donkey Kong Country: Tropical Freeze (Switch)

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead Tools Engineer overseeing core tools development for the Chicago, Baltimore, and Austin offices.

- Served as a technical leader in tools development by representing the Austin, Chicago, and Baltimore studios in a global, corporate committee of engineers, which is actively developing a next generation tools framework driven by a plugin-based architecture presently being used by all new tools development within Wargaming.net.

- Delivered tools and plugins using Wargaming's Next Generation Tools framework, which reduced the workload of studios adopting the technology.

- Assessed core systems in the game engine to significantly reduce memory footprint and code bloat.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Provided technical leadership for online development for Madden NFL - Connected Franchise Mode (CFM).

- Created a central system for the processing of game modes telemetry that works in both online and offline modes of the CFM game mode.

- Developed stress test scenarios and scripts for online game modes. Results helped to uncover data corruptions, memory corruptions, and performance problems prior to successful product launch.

- Introduced critical triage processes for live services on the CFM team. Result was highly successful launch of CFM online for Madden 25 (Gen3 and Gen4).
